## 0.6.0

### Features

- **proxy:** CONTEXT_DEBUG_SHAPES logs each request's shape, counts only (9daf862)

### Bug Fixes

- **proxy:** Pin litellm 1.109.0rc1, never inherit a base URL that points at the proxy (6cd55d8)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.6.0
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.6.0

## 0.5.0

### Features

- Scratchpad on by default; clearing and scratchpad doc pages (25645a6)
- **bench:** Rtk hook arms; skip npm ci when deps are present (f448df6)
- **scratchpad:** Keep the pad across trims, labelled possibly stale (88b7fc5)
- **scratchpad:** 2,500-char cap, structured nudge, pad first in the trim note (dc644e5)
- CONTEXT_TRIM_TO_TOKENS replaces CONTEXT_TRIM_TO_FRACTION (3a41132)
- **bench:** ScratchpadClear arm, scratchpad with masking and clear-10 (15bb376)
- Compaction scratchpad behind CONTEXT_SCRATCHPAD (b4da9c3)
- Mask all but the 10 newest tool results by default (CONTEXT_CLEAR_KEEP_RESULTS=10) (2d4b0e3)
- **site:** Build the docs with Starlight (315000c)

### Bug Fixes

- **proxy:** Pin Anthropic system messages so a trim keeps them (5ea7fb9)
- **proxy:** Restore 16f48a6, leave thinking signatures out of the token estimate (3becfea)
- **proxy:** Leave thinking signatures out of the token estimate (16f48a6)
- **plugin:** Port observation masking, prose strip and progress note to the in-process trim (7900921)
- Make plugin options, [context_store] and proxy.env settings take effect (3ba244c)
- **docs:** Point the hooks link at its published source (81edd89)
- **status:** Measure tokens saved against the billed prompt after the cut (5bbdd82)

### Refactor

- **BREAKING** Remove memory recall on trim (2a887d3)

### Documentation

- Anthropic system messages are pinned; thinking payloads left out of the estimate (3f89f82)
- Split agents and benchmarks into their own pages; retitle guide 'How it works' (0b14c4f)
- Move configuration tables to a reference page (5669cb4)
- Add quick-start page to site (66ed346)
- **store:** Drop the dead hooks link (206cbc4)

### CI

- **pages:** Deploy the Starlight site (818111c)

### Other changes

- Revert "fix(proxy): leave thinking signatures out of the token estimate" (a001af4)
- Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/bcmyguest/smarter-compact (f7973a0)
- Merge branch 'worktree-agent-a7af705c71b33141b' (75e695d)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

